title: Reliable QR Scanner & Instant Camera Auto-Shutoff
releaseNotes: Rebuilt QR code scanning for schedules and themes with native hardware detection, multi-zone decoding, autofocus, and flashlight support.
Fixed the camera staying active after closing the scanner—hardware camera access now shuts off instantly on scan, close, screen lock, or app switch.
Added live Camera Active status, one-tap Turn Off Camera controls, and reliable QR screenshot uploads.
